mentions.name: Multi-tenant app conversion
mentions.description: An app that originally shipped as a single-tenant, mono-node, per-client deployment is being converted to a multi-tenant, multi-node architecture using cloud storage and a small cluster; the current work is largely the migration and operations side rather than user-facing features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Converting an app that started per-client deploy, single-tenant, cloud-ignorant and mono-node to multi-tenant, multi-node, cloud storage and a cluster of a few nodes.

evidence.value: Converting an app that started per-client deploy, single-tenant, cloud-ignorant and mono-node to multi-tenant, multi-node, cloud storage and a cluster of a few nodes.
